purpose: Bind all durable learnings from the Make credit-storm recovery thread into one machine-readable preflight surface.

failurePatterns.symptom: An on-demand scenario continued executing when directly invoked by other scenarios even after its status was inactive.
failurePatterns.rootCause: Scenario activation state was treated as the only circuit breaker for a callable subscenario.
failurePatterns.requiredAction: Enforce an entry guard inside the callee and caller-side dispatch guards; inactive status alone is never sufficient containment for on-demand control-plane services.
failurePatterns.regression: A direct non-canonical call must terminate before the first expensive external read/write module; only the canonical owner with explicit refresh mode may enter the rebuild path.

failurePatterns.symptom: A state-changing connector action targeted the wrong resource and briefly reopened an unrelated GitHub issue.
failurePatterns.rootCause: Mutation tool/resource/identifier/intent were not matched as a precondition before dispatch.
failurePatterns.requiredAction: Before every mutation, verify tool action, resource type, exact identifier and requested intent; after an accidental mutation, restore exact prior state and read back once.
failurePatterns.regression: No state-changing call may execute when resource type or intent is unresolved or mismatched.

BG168.rule: Materiality must be decided before paid subscenario dispatch; a classifier inside BG168 cannot eliminate the dispatch cost already incurred.

requirements: runtime state distinguished from audit history
completionGate.terminalRule: A chat/run is not fully green while material learnings exist only in conversation text or while a discovered prevention gap is silently dropped.
